desc: Establish monotonicity: absorbing any eligible boundary slime only increases strength and expands adjacency, so it cannot harm future reachability.
Implement min-heap frontier expansion: mark cells discovered on heap insertion, repeatedly absorb the minimum boundary cell while `value * X < strength`, and add its undiscovered neighbors.
Run the heap implementation on all provided samples and verify the outputs.
Confirm complexity is `O(HW log(HW))` and use exact integer arithmetic for threshold comparisons and accumulated strength.
